compatibility.qtRuntimeScenarios: v1 writer + growing TS + shared AVC/AAC + shared HEVC and AV1 Main10 fractional/AAC + shared VP8/VP9/AV1 Opus WebM + optional Vorbis

mux-mp4-opus-ui-linux: A connection to the bus can't be made
mux-mp4-opus-compat-linux: A connection to the bus can't be made

limitations: Exactly two required scalar H.264/HEVC/AV1/VP9 plus Opus mono/stereo 48 kHz views of one fMP4 resource; known-duration zero-offset VOD and complete moof/mdat publication. Opus encoder fixtures use 20 ms packets, delay_moov and preserved negative timestamps.
Layout/index snapshots are copied. Worst-case memory, maximum index size and multi-hour throughput have not been stress-tested.
Container/header validation is not full elementary-stream entropy validation; decoder output remains authoritative.
Native decoded hashes and timestamp comparison do not measure physical output synchronization.
Installed Windows EXEs/INIs were not replaced.
